title: Gradient palette / Named combinations

location.extent: Representative frame; complete local motion provided

slide_intent: Keep a recurring color within changing combinations so variety can remain connected to a familiar visual reference.
strategic_value: Gradients ending in Twitch Purple can link the expanded palette to existing recognition.
demonstration: A moving portrait sequence compares gradient cards labeled with combinations of Lightning, Zero, Mega, Cuddle and Twitch Purple.
practical_value: Compare the named gradient combinations and their shared purple end without inventing numeric stop positions.

content_islands.name: Gradient card
content_islands.spec: Fill a rounded card with a vertical multicolor transition.

content_islands.name: Color labels
content_islands.spec: Place the named components at different heights on the right; repeat and move cards through the frame.

reference_purposes.Intent: COLLINS states that additional vibrant hues build on recognition of Twitch purple while representing a wider range of creators and audiences.
reference_purposes.Application: The cards identify component colors within several example gradients.
reference_purposes.Expression: Each shown combination links brighter colors to Twitch Purple.

ingredient.name: Purple-linked gradients
ingredient.role: Connect vivid variation to a familiar brand hue.
ingredient.application: Use the labeled combinations as examples; compare the changing middle and upper hues with the repeated purple end.
ingredient.scope: The case-study film supplies names and examples, not color codes, exact stop locations or a rule requiring these gradients everywhere.
